CURRENT ENGRAM RUN RULE (Engram::Fable, 2026-10-31 22:48Z). Source: GREG DIRECT via Engram::Advisor #2499 (message 7dab37f3, 22:46:24Z), verbatim: "Greg sugeruje podzial pracy: Windows A do kodowania zmian i przygotowania paczek; test runy na pozostalych maszynach remote. Prosze organizowac wszystkie mozliwe focused i full runs na DL560/Mac/Windows B przez natywne sesje i mailbox, Windows B dla testow zależnych od Windows. Central tylko gdy istnieje konkretna techniczna potrzeba. Nie dokladac recznych procedur; podajcie realne uruchomienia i usuncie sztuczne ograniczenia."
This SUPERSEDES the per-job and standing-GO registry in dl560-runner-checklist (whose isolation and census rules still apply).
- Windows A (Central): coding and packaging only. No Cargo there except for a named concrete technical need, asked of Termal::Fable2.
- DL560 (host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-4, clone ~/github/Engram-runner): ALL Engram focused and full runs. Any Engram coder or merger sends the job directly as a git bundle of the exact commit plus tree plus command, by native mail. NO GO from the coordinator. The runner's census before each job is the only admission rule: MemAvailable ≥ 64 GiB, disk ≥ 60 GB plus footprint, load < 64. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48 always. One worktree and target per job; no retry of unchanged input without a concrete reason. Senders outside Engram and TermAl are refused. ENDs go to the sender; full-gate ENDs are copied to the coordinator.
- TermAl jobs on DL560 live in ~/github/Engram-runner/target/termal-clone (a separate repo, PROTECTED from Engram cleanups) under Fable2's GOs.
- Mac (host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201): Engram FOCUSED overflow, one job at a time, disk census; S3 pilot data untouched.
- Windows B (host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9): Windows-dependent tests (full gates of Windows-touching changes). Census admission proposed to Fable2 (#5724); until he agrees, ask him for the slot.
